Type.evidence_source: Data analysis was undertaken by all authors. As recommended by Braun and Clarke (2006), the researchers initially listened to audio recordings while reading the transcripts to ensure accuracy of the content and understanding of the context of the participants' narrative. Following this step, the researchers extensively engaged in the data independently by reading and re-reading transcripts. Data were then coded, grouped into categories, and over-arching themes after which all members of the research team compared and discussed their individual findings until agreement was attained.
